title: The Ideal place for the garden
subtitle: 未来展望 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 未来展望（宇宙探索·未来与展望）
meta: 主题语境：未来展望（宇宙探索·未来与展望）　|　核心词汇：ideal　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ideal 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the musician wrote of ① an ideal place for the garden in the programme, and everybody in the hall said at once that it was ② so ideal that nobody in the hall would go near it. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the musician, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the ideal ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the ideal place for the garden that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme for December 1981 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too ideal to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the ideal ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an ideal answer to the problem, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as ideal as the answer to the problem they had once had in the old hall. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was ideal or not, and he said so.

By 1994 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something ideal, and nothing besides. The listener from the next hall called the whole plan ⑧ quite ideal; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the ideal ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1997, in silence, she wrote of another ideal place for the garden in the same programme, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ no less ideal than anybody had expected. ⑩ The ideal answer to the problem that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1999, was the one she could never quite name; the ideal ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 理想（前置定语 an ideal place for the garden：1987 年乐师在节目单里记下的那件理想的地点）
B. adj. 理想／完美（两处加强说法：so ideal that … 与 no less ideal than …）
C. adj. 理想／完美（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 理想（表语 too ideal to do：母亲觉得它太理想，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 完美（前置定语 an ideal answer to the problem：叔叔把整件事称作一桩完美的理想答案）
F. adj. 完美（同级比较 as ideal as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩问题的理想答案相比）
G. adj. 完美（后置定语 something ideal：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 完美（受程度副词修饰 quite ideal：那位听客的评价）

items.q: an ideal place for the garden
the ideal place for the garden that
an ideal answer to the problem
The ideal answer to the problem that

answers.why: ideal 意为“理想”，1987 年乐师在节目单里记下的是“一件理想的地点”，此处作前置定语 an ideal place for the garden。
ideal 意为“理想”，此处用 so ideal that 结构，说它理想到音乐厅里没人敢靠近。
ideal 意为“理想”，节目单上 十二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的理想种园子的理想地点，等于最高级的说法。
ideal 意为“理想”，母亲认为这件东西“太理想了，谁也用不上”，too ideal to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
ideal 意为“完美”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩完美的理想答案”，此处作前置定语 an ideal answer to the problem。
ideal 意为“完美”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩问题的理想答案一样完美”，同级比较用 as ideal as。
ideal 意为“完美”，节目单上那半行字要的是“完美的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something ideal。
ideal 意为“完美”，邻音乐厅来的那位听客认为这套计划“相当完美”，quite 修饰原级 ideal。
ideal 意为“完美”，no less ideal than 表示“其完美不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之完美不亚于任何人的预料。
ideal 意为“完美”，母亲 1999 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的完美理想答案”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1987 年，乐师在节目单里记下了一件理想的地点。（an ideal place for the garden）
它理想到音乐厅里没有一个人敢靠近。（so ideal that …）
母亲觉得它太理想，谁也用不上。（too ideal to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩完美的理想答案。（an ideal answer to the problem）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩问题的理想答案一样完美。（as ideal as …）
到了 1994 年，节目单上只剩半行字：要的是一件完美的东西。（something ideal）
answers: In 1987 the musician wrote of an ideal place for the garden in the programme.
It was so ideal that nobody in the hall would go near it.
My mother thought it too ideal to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an ideal answer to the problem.
He said nobody would call it as ideal as the answer to the problem they had once had.
By 1994 the programme asked for nothing but something ideal.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 ideal 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1987 the musician wrote of an ideal place for the garden in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the ideal place for the garden that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too ideal to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an ideal answer to the problem, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next hall called the plan quite ideal, and everybody laughed.
The ideal ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
